_schema_note: Live config for services/evolution/program_qualification.py. A missing, unreadable or invalid file fails closed: the qualifier drafts nothing and records the reason. Edit this file to retune; no image rebuild required.

_field_notes.policy_version: Recorded on every qualification record and report.
_field_notes.allowed_signal_types: A snapshot signal_type must be one of these. manual_review and governance_incident never qualify.
_field_notes.metric_allowlist: Only metrics that an owner can currently produce through the drift path. Sharpe, slippage, reject rate, PSI and human correction have an evaluator but no producer as of 2026-11-04.
_field_notes.denied_metrics: Metrics that never pass real_threshold_signal even if someone adds them to the allowlist.
_field_notes.allowed_artifact_types: Registry artifact_type values the target may resolve to.
_field_notes.allowed_target_stages: Registry deployment_stage values the target may be in.
_field_notes.allow_test_scope: When false a target whose persona has data_scope test (or acceptance, fixture, synthetic) is refused.
_field_notes.min_distinct_breach_days: Distinct market mark dates (as_of in the drawdown_snapshot telemetry event metadata.mark_refs) with a governed breach.
_field_notes.lookback_days: Window the breach history is read from.
_field_notes.metric_max_age_seconds: Per-metric age limit for the current runtime summary (same meaning as threshold_sweep_worker).
_field_notes.latest_evaluation_window_seconds: The most recent drift evaluation of the binding must fall inside this window.
_field_notes.max_event_reads: Upper bound on distinct telemetry events read per decision when dating breaches.
